environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. An AWS WAFv2 WebACL is associated with the ALB containing two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 0: a custom rule with a RegexPatternSet matching request query string values against pattern `(?i)(?:union[\s/\*]+select|select[\s/\*]+.*from|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*(?:or|and)\s+['"]?\d)` with action BLOCK and CloudWatch metric `SQLiCustomBlock`; (2) Priority 1: AWS managed rule group `AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet` with `SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING` rule overridden to COUNT (to allow long search terms) but all other rules in default BLOCK. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress except to the RDS/SQLite path and CloudWatch, enforced by VPC security group allowing only outbound to 169.254.170.2/32:80 (ECS credential endpoint) and 0.0.0.0/0:443 (CloudWatch). The task runs with a read-only root filesystem except /tmp mount.
